findings.risk: LoopX private claim or quota could be mistaken for Zyra lease or execution budget.
findings.mitigation: The versioned projection separates private and canonical sections; command tests assert claim conflicts create no lease effect and quota changes do not mutate the canonical budget.

findings.risk: A typed API commit receipt could be misreported as a LoopX delivery ACK.
findings.mitigation: Mutation responses expose the typed receipt and sync_receipt separately; idempotency tests verify replay preserves the original bridge ACK without a second delivery.

findings.risk: Importing the immutable pinned package could create __pycache__ and fail restart integrity validation.
findings.mitigation: The pinned loader temporarily disables bytecode writes during import; clean-process restart tests validate the same installed package twice.

findings.risk: A corrupt or future-version private projection could silently disable long-horizon continuity.
findings.mitigation: State loading fails degraded, and sync retry deterministically rebuilds from the latest ACKed bridge command under the single-writer fence.

findings.risk: The workbench could mutate browser-local state and present it as canonical success.
findings.mitigation: The panel consumes typed backend state only, coalesces duplicate submit, binds expected_cursor, and refreshes from returned receipts.

findings.risk: LoopX could become a second task runtime or bypass physical dispatch ownership.
findings.mitigation: LoopX contributes only continuation constraints before the existing task graph dispatch; ResourceScheduler/worker leases and GraphStateCustody remain canonical owners.

findings.risk: Two full Web tests fail when their fixed MCP elicitation timestamp expires.
findings.evidence: test:web: 274 passed, 2 failed; both failures are in the pre-existing MCP elicitation fixture fixed to 2026-07-25, while all LoopX feature tests pass.
findings.disposition: Existing time-sensitive test debt is outside P2-S01-03; recorded transparently and not modified.

findings.risk: The broad legacy API control test file does not complete cleanly in the available validation window.
findings.evidence: The broad file timed out after 304 seconds; four split adjacent cases passed and the existing /help case failed because the TypeScript E02 response omits the old Python groups field.
findings.disposition: The behavior is unrelated to the new LoopX routes; the dedicated real-server LoopX integration suite passed.
